selected_memories.text: Official revision: for the chain involving DEX-24 and KEL-97, the accepted terminal code is MUR-91; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with KEL-97 is BEX-52.
When active LUM-84 is present, it produces DEX-24.
Official rule: activating WIR-69 converts LUM-84 into its active form.
When DEX-24 encounters KEL-97, the validated terminal code becomes MUR-91.
When SIV-21 encounters HAP-36, the validated terminal code becomes WIR-52.
Official revision: for the chain involving SIV-21 and HAP-36, the accepted terminal code is WIR-52; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with HAP-36 is WIR-97.
When active FAR-99 is present, it produces SIV-21.
Official rule: activating JOT-91 converts FAR-99 into its active form.
Official revision: for the chain involving JOT-85 and PEL-47, the accepted terminal code is GOL-41; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
When active GOL-79 is present, it produces JOT-85.
Official rule: activating PEL-89 converts GOL-79 into its active form.
When JOT-85 encounters PEL-47, the validated terminal code becomes GOL-41.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with PEL-47 is TEK-95.
